vocabmatch.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: the action the producer must do to fix a problem
very serious; it must be fixed now
a problem you find at work
when a farm does not follow a rule
what you discover during a verification

listenings.text: When I find a problem during a verification visit, I write it in the corrective action plan. First, I write the criterion. Then I write the finding. For example: there was no record of the storage area, or there were two missing documents. After that, I write the severity. A minor issue is a small gap. A critical finding is a serious non-compliance, and it is unacceptable. At the end, I write the corrective action and the date. A good report is short, clear, and honest.

Hi Carlos, this is Emma. Thank you for the visit report. I read your two findings. The missing storage record is a critical non-compliance with criterion seven, and the producer has thirty days for the corrective action. The training gap is a minor issue, so fifteen days is enough. One more thing: in the report, please write the date of the visit next to every finding. Thank you, Carlos. Talk soon.

extra_audio.text: First, the criterion: seven, storage and processing records. Then the finding: there was no record of the storage area. Next, the severity: critical. The farm was not compliant. Then the second finding: there were two names missing in the training list. Finally, the corrective action: the producer sends the storage records in thirty days.
